notes.text: The sheet continues a sentence about the cardinal of the ens. referenced as (18), then lists the four written Sigma expressions. The reference reads (18); no replacement by another reference was made.

The upper paragraph contains the readable words A ce propos notons. A cancelled hypothèse and a cancelled parenthesized Pi pair precede the interlinear définition. The cancellation and replacement are retained as written.

Displays (*) and (**) contain visibly crossed comparisons. In (***) row a), both comparison signs are densely rewritten and currently present crossed forms. H's explicit note acknowledges an uncertain revision direction and proposes equality from the subsequent argument; that editorial preference was not used to overwrite the visible crossed forms.

The prose after (***) says the relations cannot be satisfied simultaneously, writes Sigma12=E1=E2=empty set and E1 intersection E2=empty set, and cites (16) (c). The words envisagées dans are legible. This is an account of the source passage, with no independent proof check.

The (****) display contains a clean 1 on its left and a right-hand 1 followed by a compact overwritten low form. Their shapes were compared locally. The second right-hand capital has a live Sigma outline with extra underlying crossing strokes. Neither the preceding formula nor the prose was used to remove those marks.

The revised paragraph begins Ce cas and ends by citing (3). Its inserted wording includes Car/car si on avait en = temps. Both horizontal strokes of the written = remain visible. The cancelled wording, cancelled equation, older E-like layer and the dense old/live words immediately before qui contredit are represented with their uncertainties.

The underlined heading Proposition leads to a formula beginning with capital Card and the numeral 4, followed by the three written branches labelled a), a') and b). The source's phrase after pas proceeds directly to l'un. A final parenthesis begins d'où.

The last sentence is physically cut by the source's lower black edge. Its du/des ending, brace-and-angular-mark group and final trois remain uncertain. H explicitly notes the clipping and the rewriting of the label (20). These notes describe source conditions; their content was checked against the image.
